title: wg: room-policy-04 §6.4 optional<MediaType> x<V> is ambiguous
description: Erratum. L883 "optional<MediaType> permitted_media_types<V>;" reads as a vector of optional elements, but the prose (L910-913) means an optional list; the readings encode differently. mimid implements an optional list (decision mimid-1wgh.3.17; note that bead misquotes the text). Fix: optional<MediaTypeList> or equivalent.
